# Reference codec source

`opus-1.6.1.tar.gz` is the unmodified Xiph.Org release source, including its COPYING file. The lab verifies SHA-256 `6ffcb593207be92584df15b32466ed64bbec99109f007c82205f0194572411a1` before extracting and building `opus_demo` and `opus_compare` with the existing local C toolchain. [Upstream release](https://github.com/xiph/opus/releases/tag/v1.6.1)

The RFC 8251 archive is downloaded on first use and cached locally with SHA-256 `6b26a22f9ba87b2b836906a9bb7afec5f8e54d49553b1200382520ee6fedfa55`. [Xiph.Org test vectors](https://opus-codec.org/testvectors/)
